_comment: Exact pins for every vendored dependency. Downstream builds fetch these from releases; nothing is built from a floating ref. Bump deliberately, never implicitly.

quickjs.why: quickjs-ng over bellard: first-class MSVC/CMake (needed for win-x64), test262 on every PR, and the ecosystem we lean on (txiki, rquickjs) is already here.

nativeGles.why: egl_context.cpp is engine-agnostic C++ with zero Napi; gl_bindings.cpp needs only a thin shim.

three.why: bench scenes only; not shipped in the runtime.

sdl.why: SDL2 not SDL3: every measured code path in the research used SDL2, and kmamal never shipped SDL3.
